info.name: FakeStoreAPI - Products
info.description:
Коллекция запросов и тестов для API Products (FakeStoreAPI: https://fakestoreapi.com/docs#tag/Products).
Содержит проверки для GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, фильтрации и пагинации.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Response is an array with items', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(jsonData.length).to.be.at.least(20); });

pm.test('Each product has required schema fields', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); const first = jsonData[0]; pm.expect(first).to.have.property('id').that.is.a('number'); pm.expect(first).to.have.property('title').that.is.a('string'); pm.expect(first).to.have.property('price'); pm.expect(first).to.have.property('category').that.is.a('string'); pm.expect(first).to.have.property('rating').that.is.an('object'); });
pm.test('Response time is under 2000ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(2000); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Product ID matches requested ID', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.variables.get('productId'))); });

pm.test('Product has valid title and price', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.title).to.be.a('string').and.not.be.empty; pm.expect(jsonData.price).to.be.a('number').and.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Exactly 5 products returned', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(jsonData.length).to.eql(5); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Products are sorted descending by ID', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.length).to.be.above(1); for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length - 1; i++) { pm.expect(jsonData[i].id).to.be.above(jsonData[i + 1].id); } });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Categories is array of strings with known categories', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(jsonData).to.include.members(['electronics', 'jewelery', "men's clothing", "women's clothing"]); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('All returned products belong to jewelery category', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; jsonData.forEach(item => { pm.expect(item.category).to.eql('jewelery'); }); });

body.raw:
{
  "title": "QA Test Wireless Headphones",
  "price": 99.99,
  "description": "High fidelity noise-cancelling headphones for testing.",
  "image": "https://i.pravatar.cc/300",
  "category": "electronics"
}

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 or 201 Created', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('Response returns created product with generated ID', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(jsonData.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(jsonData.title).to.eql('QA Test Wireless Headphones'); pm.expect(jsonData.price).to.eql(99.99); pm.expect(jsonData.category).to.eql('electronics'); });

body.raw:
{
  "title": "QA Test Wireless Headphones Updated",
  "price": 129.99,
  "description": "Updated version 2.0 with spatial audio.",
  "image": "https://i.pravatar.cc/300",
  "category": "electronics"
}

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Product details updated successfully', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.title).to.eql('QA Test Wireless Headphones Updated'); pm.expect(jsonData.price).to.eql(129.99); pm.expect(jsonData.description).to.eql('Updated version 2.0 with spatial audio.'); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Updated field is returned correctly', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.price).to.eql(89.99); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Deleted product returned in response', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(jsonData.id).to.eql(6); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Returns empty array for non-existent category', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });
